import { Colors, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import React from 'react';
import { SafeAreaView, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text } from 'react-native';

export default function PrivacyScreen() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeArea}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <Text style={styles.updated}>Last updated: March 15, 2026</Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>1. Information We Collect</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          We collect personal information you provide during registration (name, email, phone),
          farm data (GPS coordinates, harvest photos, crop details), and device information
          (operating system, app version) to deliver and improve our services.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>2. How We Use Your Information</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          Your data is used to: provide harvest management services, connect you with buyers,
          generate analytics and market insights, sync your data across devices, and send
          notifications about orders and market updates.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>3. Location Data</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          The App collects precise GPS coordinates to map farm boundaries and verify harvest
          locations. Location data is only collected when you use farm mapping features and can
          be disabled in your device settings at any time.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>4. Data Storage & Security</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          Your data is stored on secure servers with industry-standard encryption. Offline data is
          stored locally on your device and encrypted at rest. We implement access controls,
          audit logging, and regular security reviews.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>5. Data Sharing</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          We do not sell your personal data. We may share anonymized, aggregated data with
          research partners to improve agricultural practices. Buyer-facing data (crop listings,
          quantities) is shared only with buyers you interact with through the marketplace.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>6. Your Rights</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          You have the right to: access and export your data, correct inaccurate information,
          delete your account and associated data, opt out of marketing communications, and
          restrict processing of your data.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>7. Cookies & Tracking</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          The App uses minimal analytics to understand usage patterns and improve performance.
          We do not use third-party advertising trackers. You can opt out of analytics in
          Notification Preferences.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>8. Children's Privacy</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          The App is not intended for users under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from
          minors. If we discover that a minor has created an account, we will promptly delete the
          associated data.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>9. Changes to This Policy</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes
          through the App. Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>10. Contact</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          For privacy-related inquiries, contact our Data Protection Officer at
          privacy@agridirect.farm.
        </Text>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safeArea: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.light.backgroundSoft },
  container: { padding: Spacing.xl, paddingBottom: Spacing['4xl'] },
  updated: {
    fontSize: 12,
    color: Colors.light.textSecondary,
    marginBottom: Spacing.xl,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
    fontWeight: '500',
  },
  heading: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: Colors.light.text,
    marginTop: Spacing.xl,
    marginBottom: Spacing.sm,
  },
  body: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: Colors.light.textSecondary,
    lineHeight: 22,
  },
});

import { Colors, Spacing } from '@/constants/theme';
import React from 'react';
import { SafeAreaView, ScrollView, StyleSheet, Text } from 'react-native';

export default function TermsScreen() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={styles.safeArea}>
      <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.container} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
        <Text style={styles.updated}>Last updated: March 15, 2026</Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>1. Acceptance of Terms</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          By accessing or using the Tellus / AgriDirect mobile application ("App"), you agree to be
          bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, please discontinue use of the App
          immediately.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>2. Eligibility</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          You must be at least 18 years of age and legally capable of entering into a binding
          agreement to use the App. By registering, you confirm that the information you provide is
          accurate and complete.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>3. User Accounts</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
          Notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorized access. We reserve the right to
          suspend accounts that violate these terms.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>4. Harvest Data & Content</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          You retain ownership of all harvest data, photographs, and farm information you submit.
          By uploading content, you grant AgriDirect a non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use
          this data to provide and improve our services.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>5. Marketplace Conduct</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          All transactions between farmers and buyers are facilitated through the App. AgriDirect
          does not guarantee the quality, quantity, or delivery of goods. Users are responsible for
          fulfilling their obligations under any agreed-upon transactions.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>6. Offline Functionality</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          The App may store data locally on your device for offline use. This data will be synced to
          our servers when a network connection is available. We are not liable for data loss due to
          device failure before synchronization.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>7. Limitation of Liability</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          AgriDirect shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
          arising from the use of the App, including but not limited to loss of crops, revenue, or
          data.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>8. Changes to Terms</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the App after changes
          constitutes acceptance. We will notify users of material changes through the App or via
          email.
        </Text>

        <Text style={styles.heading}>9. Contact</Text>
        <Text style={styles.body}>
          For questions regarding these terms, contact us at legal@agridirect.farm.
        </Text>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safeArea: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: Colors.light.backgroundSoft },
  container: { padding: Spacing.xl, paddingBottom: Spacing['4xl'] },
  updated: {
    fontSize: 12,
    color: Colors.light.textSecondary,
    marginBottom: Spacing.xl,
    fontStyle: 'italic',
    fontWeight: '500',
  },
  heading: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: Colors.light.text,
    marginTop: Spacing.xl,
    marginBottom: Spacing.sm,
  },
  body: {
    fontSize: 14,
    color: Colors.light.textSecondary,
    lineHeight: 22,
  },
});
